declaration.candidate_semantics: network = the committee mix's network table as a weighted mean of seed ensembles (v26: ens_nn 0.5 + ens_new 0.5, the 32 nnb seeds); network_share = its weight in the committee mix table (committee share 1 - network_share; v26 0.5). The context network touches only non-LIRF rows through that table (it is fitted without LIRF like nnb); LIRF blends, residual stage, outer weight 0.7 and floor stay v26's.

control.recipe: v26 = configs/adsb_rnn_v1.json candidate rnet_w90 (the adsb_nn2 k32_m30_u25 committee mix, LIRF blends and floor with the residual 0.05 adj2 + 0.05 cat + 0.9 rnet)
control.reproduction: the control must reproduce these to 1e-9 s on every recipe month before any candidate is read

execution.declared_before: any development fit or score of the context network
execution.network_hosts: Azure arcw0-arcw7, two lanes per worker (seeds 101-108 lane A on arcw0-7, 109-116 lane B), 8 threads per lane
execution.smoke_test: tools/run_adsb_ctx_dev.py --smoke (to be written while the fits run): every ens_ctx replaced by the v26 network table so every candidate collapses onto the control; must reproduce the control on all four months before --score

external_data: adsb.lol globe_history (ODbL) via the committee's ADS-B tables and match tables
IEM weather and OurAirports runways via the timeline bundle

network.ensemble: ens_ctx = per-fold seed mean over the 16 learners (tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py convention), every leaf checked against the declared variant, code, configuration and seed
network.folds: seasonal (predicts 2025-01/07), forward (2025-11), refit (Jan-Nov; December leaf cache runs/december/learners/runs__adsb_ctx__ctx_s<seed>.parquet, ranking), refit12 (Jan-Dec; ranking), run in that order per seed by tools/ctx_chain.sh

declaration.purpose: Declared development of the context network (src/prc2026_ctx) as the committee mix's network table, against the shipped v26 recipe.
declaration.selection: A candidate is eligible when: no recipe month is worse on ALL rows (ratio to the control <= 1.0); the mean ratio over the four recipe months is at least 0.02% below 1; and on every month where it changes a row the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of the RMSE difference against the control lies below zero. Among eligible candidates choose the lowest mean ratio (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep v26. The rule of adsb_nn/nn2, unchanged.
declaration.ship: If a candidate is selected: ranking tables from the refit12 seed means; the shipped v26 ranking values are rebuilt from their recorded components with the control's tables and must reproduce the uploaded v26 exactly; then the selected pool is applied, exported as the next version through the frozen submission contract, verified independently (every saved context network reloaded and re-predicted on its token and feature inputs), audited (tools/audit_export.py), and uploaded only with the user's approval.
